text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I'm walking around the
academy...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Murgh... I just need to calm down and
think
clearly. There must be a way to
train in both form
and function...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Eep!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Th-that was close. Half a step later, and
I
would've run right into you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry! Were you hurt? I was so lost
in my
thoughts, I didn't realize you were
there!
choice_data_list: ちゃんと前を見て歩こうな
ちゃんと前を見て歩こうね
choice_data_list_en: Make sure you watch where you're walking, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's such a relief! And you're right,
I'll have
to take care not to get
distracted while walking
around.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
W-well... I've been trying to figure out
what type
of training is best suited to
me...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
You're right! Just because you water the
ground
diligently doesn't mean
seedlings will soon sprout.
choice_data_list: いろいろ試してみるとか？
choice_data_list_en: How about focusing thoroughly on just one kind?
How about trying out different things?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
In other words, "a rose garden isn't built
in a day."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wow, such words of wisdom! I'll have to
write that
one down in my notebook
later!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
All right! The time for indecision is over!
I'll
choose a single method and focus all
my efforts
on it!
choice_data_list: （似たことわざがあったような……）
choice_data_list_en: (I feel like there was a proverb like that...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! Now that I'm free of distractions,
I feel
like I can fully devote myself to
training!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I won't ever forget your kindness today. I
promise
to pay you back when we meet
next!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'll be seeing you, then! Goodbye!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O runs off towards the
training
gym.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see. You have a point. I won't know
what
method suits me if I don't try
different ones.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"The more you sow, the more you grow,"
right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, now those are some wise words! I
better
write that down before I forget.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm going to test out all the
training
styles I can at school!
choice_data_list: （格言というか、当たり前のことのような）
choice_data_list_en: (Less of a maxim and more of just stating the obvious...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, the fog in my mind has
lifted! I can
finally see the path forward!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I won't ever forget your kindness today. I
promise
to pay you back when we meet
next!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No, it's the right thing to do. You really
helped
me out!
choice_data_list: い、いや、そんな大げさだって

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If you ever need help, please do not
hesitate to
ask. It would be my pleasure
to aid you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Well, I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O smiles warmly at me,
then
leaves.
